exercises.explain: One dot below the bowl. Compare to Pe (three dots below) and Te (two dots above).

exercises.prompt: Trace Alef, then write it freehand five times.
exercises.strokeNote: A single vertical stroke, top to bottom. No lifting the pen.

exercises.prompt: Write "bâbâ" (dad) in Persian script using Be and Alef.
Match each letter to its name.
Which letter is missing? ن_ن spells نان (nân — bread).
Listen and type the letter you hear.
Put these letters in the order the book teaches them (earliest first).
Say five words out loud that you can now sound out using just Alef, Be, and Noon.
rubric: Sounded out letter-by-letter rather than guessed
Checked pronunciation against the audio for each letter
